required_runtime_changes: Add an inference stage before current select_family validation; current contract validates a supplied dominant_family but does not infer it from Creative Fit.
Inference input must contain company_truth, customer_decision_state and exactly the accepted Creative Fit dimensions; Production Feasibility fields must hard-fail if present at this stage.
Represent family matching as explicit decision-job rules and collision resolution, not as fixed-layout mapping and not as fabricated probabilistic precision.
Support one dominant family plus zero-or-more secondary influences and acceptable alternatives.
Return HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED when explicit collision rules cannot resolve co-dominance.
Run Production Feasibility adaptation only after the selector result is frozen; adaptation may not change family.
Preserve provenance from company truth and fit annotations into selector output.
Do not introduce a numeric Template Resemblance threshold as part of selector work.

required_assertions: all feasibility counterfactuals preserve dominant family
prohibited/misfit families are never silently substituted
family output does not contain layout_id
co-dominant unresolved inputs trigger human review
selector provenance records fit dimensions and decision-state basis

architecture_comparison.issue47_gap_exposed_by_issue49: The current select_family path validates a dominant family already present in the Creative Fit profile. It does not autonomously infer the family from the 23 dimensions and customer decision state.
architecture_comparison.issue49_resolution: Use selector_rule_proposal_v1 as the evidence-backed inference layer before the existing validation contract.

must_remain_human_reviewed: premium-authority vs provenance cases where neither leads
clinical reassurance vs mechanism proof where neither leads
forbidden: numeric weights presented as calibrated probabilities
silent forced winner under unresolved ambiguity
